question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation form a paired attainment.
Such attainment leads to becoming dear to yoginīs.
inference: One who attains great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: He may become dear to the yoginīs, possessing the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation.
